## Invoice with an e-invoice

![First page of the invoice with an e-invoice template](/gallery/invoice.webp)

A two-page invoice of a fictional studio: page 1 holds the lines in a `PdfTable` and the totals, page 2 the project context and scope under a running head. The PDF carries the same invoice as Factur-X XML (profile EN 16931), so it is a PDF/A-3b file that accounting software reads without typing. The totals on the page come from `computeEInvoice`, the function that also writes the XML, so the printed invoice and the XML agree.

Uses: [E-invoices]($docs.e-invoices), [PDF/A and Factur-X]($docs.pdf-a-and-factur-x), [Table components]($docs.tables), [Reusable components]($docs.reusable-components), [Page tokens]($docs.primitives#page-tokens), [Images]($docs.images-and-fonts).

Source: [`playground/pdfs/invoice.vue`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/invoice.vue), with [`pdfs/components/invoice/InvoiceBrief.vue`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/invoice/InvoiceBrief.vue), [`pdfs/components/invoice/InvoiceLine.vue`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/invoice/InvoiceLine.vue), [`pdfs/components/invoice/InvoicePage.vue`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/invoice/InvoicePage.vue), [`pdfs/components/invoice/InvoiceSection.vue`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/invoice/InvoiceSection.vue), [`pdfs/components/invoice/e-invoice.ts`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/invoice/e-invoice.ts), [`pdfs/components/theme.css`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/theme.css), [`pdfs/components/theme.ts`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/theme.ts), [`shared/invoice.ts`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/shared/invoice.ts).

```vue [playground/pdfs/invoice.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { PdfTableColumn } from '@lupinum/nuxt-pdf'
import type { Invoice } from '../shared/invoice'
import {
  compactInvoice,
  formatInvoiceMoney,
  sampleInvoice,
} from '../shared/invoice'
import { toEInvoice } from './components/invoice/e-invoice'
import InvoiceBrief from './components/invoice/InvoiceBrief.vue'
import InvoiceLine from './components/invoice/InvoiceLine.vue'
import InvoicePage from './components/invoice/InvoicePage.vue'
import InvoiceSection from './components/invoice/InvoiceSection.vue'
import { theme } from './components/theme'

defineOptions({ name: 'FieldnoteInvoicePdf' })

type InvoiceProps = {
  invoice: Invoice
}

const props = defineProps<InvoiceProps>()
const invoice = props.invoice
// The machine-readable copy of this invoice (Factur-X, profile EN 16931).
// computeEInvoice (auto-imported) gives the totals the server writes into
// its XML, so the page prints exactly those.
const eInvoice = toEInvoice(invoice)
const totals = computeEInvoice(eInvoice)
const money = (value: string) => formatInvoiceMoney(Number(value), invoice.currency)
// Drop floating-point noise (0.085 * 100 = 8.500000000000002) but keep rates such as 8.25%.
const taxPercent = `${Number((invoice.taxRate * 100).toFixed(4))}%`

// #, description (takes the free width), quantity, rate, amount. The three
// figures are right-aligned, in the header and in every line.
const lineColumns: PdfTableColumn[] = [
  '26pt',
  1,
  { width: '44pt', align: 'right' },
  { width: '74pt', align: 'right' },
  { width: '80pt', align: 'right' },
]

// The meta strip and the two address blocks, each a label and its value.
const meta = [
  ['Issued', invoice.issueDate],
  ['Due', invoice.dueDate],
  ['Purchase order', invoice.purchaseOrder],
  ['Currency', invoice.currency],
] as const
const parties = [['From', invoice.from], ['Bill to', invoice.customer]] as const

definePdf<InvoiceProps>({
  title: ({ invoice }) => `Invoice ${invoice.number}`,
  filename: ({ invoice }) => `fieldnote-invoice-${invoice.number}.pdf`,
  language: 'en-GB',
  sampleData: { invoice: sampleInvoice },
  scenarios: {
    compact: { invoice: compactInvoice },
    twoPage: { invoice: sampleInvoice },
  },
})
</script>

<template>

         PDF/A-3b, so every text uses a registered font: Inter, set on the
         .page class. -->

      :invoice="eInvoice"
      profile="EN 16931"
    />

    <InvoicePage
      head-pages="continuation"

          </PdfText>
          <PdfText class="customer-name">

        <PdfView class="amount-due tabular">

          </PdfText>
          <PdfText class="amount-due-value">

        >
          <PdfText class="label">
            {{ label }}
          </PdfText>
          <PdfText class="meta-value">
            {{ value }}
          </PdfText>
        </PdfView>
      </PdfView>

      <PdfView
        class="parties"
        :wrap="false"
      >
        <PdfView
          v-for="[label, party] in parties"
          :key="label"
          class="party"
        >
          <PdfText class="label">
            {{ label }}
          </PdfText>
          <PdfText class="party-name">
            {{ party.name }}
          </PdfText>
          <PdfText
            v-for="line in [...party.address, party.email]"
            :key="line"
            class="party-line"
          >
            {{ line }}
          </PdfText>
        </PdfView>
      </PdfView>

      <InvoiceSection
        label="Services"
        title="Engagement summary"
      >
        <!-- The card around the table: a rounded border, as a shadcn Table. -->
        <PdfView class="card table-card tabular">
          <PdfTable :columns="lineColumns">
            <!-- Repeats at the top of every page the table reaches. -->
            <PdfTableHeader class="line-header">
              <PdfTableCell>#</PdfTableCell>
              <PdfTableCell>Description</PdfTableCell>
              <PdfTableCell>Qty</PdfTableCell>
              <PdfTableCell>Rate</PdfTableCell>
              <PdfTableCell>Amount</PdfTableCell>
            </PdfTableHeader>
            <InvoiceLine
              v-for="(line, index) in invoice.lines"
              :key="line.id"
              :currency="invoice.currency"
              :index="index"
              :line="line"
            />
          </PdfTable>
        </PdfView>
      </InvoiceSection>

      <PdfView
        :min-presence-ahead="108"
        class="totals tabular"
        :wrap="false"
      >
        <PdfView class="totals-box">
          <PdfView class="total-row">
            <PdfText class="total-label">
              Subtotal
            </PdfText>
            <PdfText class="total-value">
              {{ money(totals.taxBasisTotal) }}
            </PdfText>
          </PdfView>
          <PdfView class="total-row">
            <PdfText class="total-label">
              VAT {{ taxPercent }}
            </PdfText>
            <PdfText class="total-value">
              {{ money(totals.taxTotal) }}
            </PdfText>
          </PdfView>
          <PdfView class="grand-total">
            <PdfText class="grand-total-label">
              Total due
            </PdfText>
            <PdfText class="grand-total-value">
              {{ money(totals.grandTotal) }}
            </PdfText>
          </PdfView>
        </PdfView>
      </PdfView>

      <PdfView
        class="card payment-note"
        :wrap="false"
      >
        <PdfText class="payment-note-title">
          Payment note
        </PdfText>
        <PdfText class="payment-note-text">
          {{ invoice.paymentNote }}
        </PdfText>
      </PdfView>
    </InvoicePage>

    <InvoicePage
      v-if="invoice.includeBrief"
      head-pages="all"
      :invoice-number="invoice.number"
      footer-href="https://nuxt-pdf.lupinum.com"
      footer-label="Generated with Nuxt PDF"
      class="page"
    >
      <InvoiceBrief
        :brief="invoice.projectBrief"
        :invoice-number="invoice.number"
      />
    </InvoicePage>
  </PdfDocument>
</template>
```

```css [playground/pdfs/components/theme.css]
/* Rules every playground template shares. The colours and radii are the
   variables that the importing template binds in its :root from theme.ts. */

/* Caption above a value: small, medium weight, sentence case, muted. */
.label {
  margin-bottom: 4pt;
  font-size: 7.5pt;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}

/* An outlined pill: "Invoice", "Project context". */
.badge {
  align-self: flex-start;
  padding: 2.5pt 8pt;
  border: 1pt solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 999pt;
}

.badge-text {
  font-size: 7pt;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--foreground);
}

/* The accent pill for a status: "Due 19 August 2026". */
.badge-accent {
  border-color: var(--accent-border);
  background-color: var(--accent-soft);
}

.badge-accent .badge-text {
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* A number in a small muted square: steps, deliverables, chapters. */
.number-badge {
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  width: 18pt;
  height: 18pt;
  border-radius: var(--radius-small);
  background-color: var(--muted);
}

.number-badge-text {
  font-size: 7.5pt;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--foreground);
}

/* Digits of one width, so amounts line up in a column. Inherited: set it on
   the block that holds the figures (a table, the totals, a chart). */
.tabular {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/* A rounded bordered card. */
.card {
  border: 1pt solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
}
```

## Registration form

![First page of the registration form template](/gallery/registration.webp)

A one-page workshop registration that the recipient fills in and saves in a PDF reader. It has text fields, a drop-down list, a radio group and checkboxes, each with a label and sized by classes in the `<style>` block. A second scenario fills the form for a returning participant, so the same template prints a blank and a filled form.

Uses: [Fillable forms]($docs.forms), [Radio groups]($docs.forms#make-a-radio-group), [Styles]($docs.styles), [definePdf scenarios]($docs.define-pdf).

Source: [`playground/pdfs/registration.vue`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/registration.vue), with [`pdfs/components/theme.css`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/theme.css), [`pdfs/components/theme.ts`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/theme.ts), [`shared/registration.ts`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/shared/registration.ts).

::collapse
```vue [playground/pdfs/registration.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Registration } from '../shared/registration'
import { experienceLevels, returningParticipant, sampleRegistration } from '../shared/registration'
import { theme } from './components/theme'

defineOptions({ name: 'WorkshopRegistrationPdf' })

type RegistrationProps = { registration: Registration }

const props = defineProps<RegistrationProps>()
const registration = props.registration

definePdf<RegistrationProps>({
  title: ({ registration }) => `Registration: ${registration.workshop}`,
  filename: () => 'workshop-registration.pdf',
  language: 'en',
  sampleData: { registration: sampleRegistration },
  scenarios: {
    returning: { registration: returningParticipant },
  },
})
</script>

<template>
  <PdfDocument
    creator="Nuxt PDF"
    subject="Workshop registration form"
  >
    <PdfPage
      size="A5"
      class="page"
    >
      <PdfView class="badge">
        <PdfText class="badge-text">
          Fieldnote Studio · Registration
        </PdfText>
      </PdfView>
      <PdfText class="title">
        {{ registration.workshop }}
      </PdfText>
      <PdfText class="meta">
        {{ registration.date }} · {{ registration.venue }}
      </PdfText>
      <PdfText class="intro">
        Fill in this form in your PDF reader, save it, and send it back to us.
      </PdfText>

      <!-- Form fields have square borders, so each field sits without a
           border in a rounded box, as a shadcn Input. -->
      <PdfText class="field-label">
        Full name
      </PdfText>
      <PdfView class="input">
        <PdfTextField
          name="fullName"
          label="Full name"
          :value="registration.participant"
          :max-length="60"
          required
          class="field"
        />
      </PdfView>

      <PdfText class="field-label">
        Email
      </PdfText>
      <PdfView class="input">
        <PdfTextField
          name="email"
          label="Email"
          required
          class="field"
        />
      </PdfView>

      <PdfText class="field-label">
        Session
      </PdfText>
      <PdfView class="input">
        <PdfSelect
          name="session"
          label="Session"
          :options="registration.sessions"
          :value="registration.sessions[0]"
          class="field"
        />
      </PdfView>

      <PdfText class="field-label">
        What do you want to record?
      </PdfText>
      <PdfView class="input">
        <PdfTextField
          name="interests"
          label="What do you want to record?"
          multiline
          class="field field-tall"
        />
      </PdfView>

      <PdfText class="field-label">
        Recording experience
      </PdfText>
      <PdfView class="options">
        <PdfView
          v-for="level in experienceLevels"
          :key="level.value"
          class="option"
        >
          <PdfRadio
            name="experience"
            :value="level.value"
            :label="level.label"
            :checked="registration.experience === level.value"
            class="radio"
          />
          <PdfText class="choice-text">
            {{ level.label }}
          </PdfText>
        </PdfView>
      </PdfView>

      <PdfView class="choices">
        <PdfView class="choice">
          <PdfView class="checkbox">
            <PdfCheckbox
              name="ownRecorder"
              label="I bring my own recorder"
              class="box"
            />
          </PdfView>
          <PdfText class="choice-text">
            I bring my own recorder
          </PdfText>
        </PdfView>
        <PdfView class="choice">
          <PdfView class="checkbox">
            <PdfCheckbox
              name="newsletter"
              label="Send me the studio newsletter"
              checked
              class="box"
            />
          </PdfView>
          <PdfText class="choice-text">
            Send me the studio newsletter
          </PdfText>
        </PdfView>
      </PdfView>
    </PdfPage>
  </PdfDocument>
</template>

  flex-direction: row;
}
.option {
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  margin-right: 18pt;
}
.radio {
  width: 11pt;
  height: 11pt;
  padding: 2.5pt;
  border-width: 1pt;
  border-color: var(--control-border);
}
</style>
```

## Article from a CMS

![First page of the article from a CMS template](/gallery/article.webp)

A journal post as a headless CMS delivers it: the HTML that a rich text editor saved, printed by `PdfRichText`. It shows headings, lists, a quote, code, a link and a photo with a caption, and the headings become bookmarks. One class sets the text size, and the `styles` prop sets the headings, quotes, code and links; the same template also prints a post written in Markdown.

Uses: [Rich text]($docs.rich-text), [Images in rich text]($docs.rich-text#images), [Bookmarks]($docs.contents-links-bookmarks), [Fonts]($docs.images-and-fonts).

Source: [`playground/pdfs/article.vue`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/article.vue), with [`pdfs/components/article/ArticleCallout.vue`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/article/ArticleCallout.vue), [`pdfs/components/theme.ts`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/theme.ts), [`shared/article.ts`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/shared/article.ts).

::collapse
```vue [playground/pdfs/article.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { PdfRichTextStyles } from '@lupinum/nuxt-pdf'
import type { Article } from '../shared/article'
import { sampleArticle } from '../shared/article'
import ArticleCallout from './components/article/ArticleCallout.vue'
import { articleTheme } from './components/theme'

defineOptions({ name: 'JournalArticlePdf' })

type ArticleProps = { article: Article }

const props = defineProps<ArticleProps>()
const article = props.article

// The comark components a Markdown body may name (`::callout`).
const components = { callout: ArticleCallout }

// Serif headings in Cormorant, quotes as a pull quote in its italic, and the
// journal's colours for code, links and rules. Literata is registered up to
// weight 600, so bold text uses it. Everything else follows the body text set
// by the `body` class.
const styles: PdfRichTextStyles = {
  h2: { fontFamily: articleTheme.display, fontWeight: 600 },
  h3: { fontFamily: articleTheme.display, fontWeight: 600 },
  strong: { fontWeight: 600 },
  quote: {
    fontFamily: articleTheme.display,
    fontStyle: 'italic',
    fontWeight: 500,
    fontSize: 13,
    lineHeight: 1.35,
    borderLeftWidth: 1.5,
    borderLeftColor: articleTheme.accent,
    color: articleTheme.ink,
  },
  code: { backgroundColor: articleTheme.tint },
  codeBlock: { backgroundColor: articleTheme.tint, borderRadius: 3, padding: 8 },
  link: { color: articleTheme.accent },
  rule: { borderTopWidth: 0.75, borderTopColor: articleTheme.hairline },
  caption: { fontStyle: 'italic', color: articleTheme.muted },
}

definePdf<ArticleProps>({
  title: ({ article }) => article.title,
  filename: () => 'journal-article.pdf',
  language: 'en',
  sampleData: { article: sampleArticle },
})
</script>

<template>
  <PdfDocument
    creator="Nuxt PDF"
    subject="Fieldnote Studio journal"
  >
    <PdfPage
      size="A5"
      class="page"
    >
      <PdfText class="kicker">
        Fieldnote Studio · Journal
      </PdfText>
      <PdfText
        tag="h1"
        class="title"
      >
        {{ article.title }}
      </PdfText>
      <PdfText class="meta">
        {{ article.author }} · {{ article.published }}
      </PdfText>
      <PdfRichText
        class="body"
        :html="article.body"
        :content="article.content"
        :components="components"
        :styles="styles"
        bookmarks
      />
      <PdfText
        fixed
        class="folio"
      >
        Fieldnote Studio journal · <PdfPageNumber />
      </PdfText>
    </PdfPage>
  </PdfDocument>
</template>

<style>
/* The article's own look (articleTheme in components/theme.ts). */
:root {
  --paper: v-bind('articleTheme.paper');
  --ink: v-bind('articleTheme.ink');
  --muted: v-bind('articleTheme.muted');
  --hairline: v-bind('articleTheme.hairline');
  --accent: v-bind('articleTheme.accent');
  --display: v-bind('articleTheme.display');
  --reading: v-bind('articleTheme.reading');
}
.page {
  hyphens: auto;
  text-wrap: pretty;
  padding: 40pt 40pt 52pt;
  font-family: var(--reading);
  background-color: var(--paper);
  color: var(--ink);
}
.kicker {
  font-size: 7.5pt;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--accent);
}
.title {
  margin-top: 8pt;
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 27pt;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.05;
}
.meta {
  margin-top: 8pt;
  margin-bottom: 16pt;
  padding-bottom: 12pt;
  border-bottom: 0.75pt solid var(--hairline);
  font-size: 8pt;
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.body {
  font-size: 9.5pt;
  line-height: 1.6;
}
.folio {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 24pt;
  left: 40pt;
  font-size: 7pt;
  color: var(--muted);
}
</style>
```

## E-book

![First page of the e-book template](/gallery/ebook.webp)

A small-format e-book with a cover drawn with SVG, a contents page, and chapters that each start on a new page. The contents page prints the page on which each chapter starts with `PdfPageRef`, and each entry links to its chapter. A running head repeats on every body page, and the running foot names the chapter that the page belongs to.

Uses: [Table of contents]($docs.contents-links-bookmarks), [Fixed content and pages]($docs.page-breaking#fixed-content-and-pages), [Page breaks]($docs.page-breaking#page-breaks), [SVG graphics]($docs.svg-graphics), [Reusable components]($docs.reusable-components).

Source: [`playground/pdfs/ebook.vue`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/ebook.vue), with [`pdfs/components/ebook/EbookContents.vue`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/ebook/EbookContents.vue), [`pdfs/components/ebook/EbookCover.vue`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/ebook/EbookCover.vue), [`pdfs/components/ebook/EbookReeds.vue`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/ebook/EbookReeds.vue), [`pdfs/components/ebook/EbookTitlePage.vue`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/ebook/EbookTitlePage.vue), [`pdfs/components/theme.ts`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/theme.ts), [`shared/ebook.ts`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/shared/ebook.ts).

::collapse
```vue [playground/pdfs/ebook.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Ebook } from '../shared/ebook'
import { sampleEbook, shortEbook, splitLeadIn } from '../shared/ebook'
import EbookContents from './components/ebook/EbookContents.vue'
import EbookCover from './components/ebook/EbookCover.vue'
import EbookTitlePage from './components/ebook/EbookTitlePage.vue'
import { ebookTheme } from './components/theme'

defineOptions({ name: 'EbookPdf' })

type EbookProps = { ebook: Ebook }

const props = defineProps<EbookProps>()
const ebook = props.ebook

// Precompute the small-caps lead-in split (first four words, uppercased) and the
// remaining body once per chapter, so the template stays declarative.
const chapters = ebook.chapters.map((chapter, index) => ({
  ...chapter,
  first: index === 0,
  lead: splitLeadIn(chapter.paragraphs[0] ?? ''),
  body: chapter.paragraphs.slice(1),
}))

definePdf<EbookProps>({
  title: ({ ebook }) => ebook.title,
  filename: ({ ebook }) => `${ebook.title.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')}.pdf`,
  language: 'en',
  sampleData: { ebook: sampleEbook },
  scenarios: {
    short: { ebook: shortEbook },
  },
})
</script>

<template>
  <PdfDocument
    :author="ebook.author"
    :conformance="['PDF/A-3a', 'PDF/UA-1']"
    creator="Nuxt PDF"
    :subject="ebook.subtitle"
  >
    <!-- 1 · Cover and 2 · title page without running matter, 3 · contents
         with the page each chapter starts on (PdfPageRef). -->
    <EbookCover :ebook="ebook" />
    <EbookTitlePage :ebook="ebook" />
    <EbookContents :ebook="ebook" />

    <!-- 4 · The body: one flow in which each chapter starts a new page. The
         running head and the chapter's foot repeat on every page. -->
    <PdfPage
      :size="[396, 612]"
      class="page body-page"
    >
      <PdfView
        fixed
        class="running-head"
      >
        <PdfText class="running-title">
          {{ ebook.title }}
        </PdfText>
        <PdfText class="running-author">
          {{ ebook.author }}
        </PdfText>
      </PdfView>

      <!-- The chapter's id and bookmark point at the page where it starts.
           flexGrow fills its last page, so the foot sits at the page bottom. -->
      <PdfView
        v-for="chapter in chapters"
        :id="chapter.id"
        :key="chapter.id"
        :break="!chapter.first"
        :bookmark="chapter.title"
        class="chapter"
        tag="section"
      >
        <!-- A fixed node repeats on every page its parent spans, so each
             chapter prints its own title next to the page number. -->
        <PdfText
          fixed
          class="running-foot"
        >
          {{ chapter.title }}   ·   <PdfPageNumber />
        </PdfText>

        <PdfView :class="['chapter-head', { 'chapter-head-following': !chapter.first }]">
          <PdfText class="chapter-label">
            Chapter {{ chapter.numeral }}
          </PdfText>
          <PdfText
            class="chapter-title"
            tag="h2"
          >
            {{ chapter.title }}
          </PdfText>
          <PdfText class="standfirst">
            {{ chapter.standfirst }}
          </PdfText>
        </PdfView>

        <!-- The first paragraph opens with a letter-spaced lead-in; one line,
             so no whitespace splits the lead-in from the text. -->
        <!-- eslint-disable-next-line vue/max-attributes-per-line, vue/singleline-html-element-content-newline -->
        <PdfText class="paragraph" :orphans="2" :widows="2"><PdfText class="lead-in">{{ chapter.lead.lead }}</PdfText>{{ chapter.lead.rest }}</PdfText>

        <PdfText
          v-for="(paragraph, index) in chapter.body"
          :key="index"
          :orphans="2"
          class="paragraph"
          :widows="2"
        >
          {{ paragraph }}
        </PdfText>
      </PdfView>
    </PdfPage>
  </PdfDocument>
</template>

<style>
/* The e-book's own look (ebookTheme in components/theme.ts): Cormorant for
   the display lines, Literata for the reading text. */
:root {
  --paper: v-bind('ebookTheme.paper');
  --ink: v-bind('ebookTheme.ink');
  --muted: v-bind('ebookTheme.muted');
  --hairline: v-bind('ebookTheme.hairline');
  --accent: v-bind('ebookTheme.accent');
  --display: v-bind('ebookTheme.display');
  --reading: v-bind('ebookTheme.reading');
  --page-margin: 54pt;
}

.page {
  hyphens: auto;
  text-wrap: pretty;
  padding: 60pt var(--page-margin);
  font-family: var(--reading);
  color: var(--ink);
  background-color: var(--paper);
}

.body-page {
  padding-top: 68pt;
  padding-bottom: 62pt;
}

.running-head {
  position: absolute;
  top: 36pt;
  right: var(--page-margin);
  left: var(--page-margin);
  flex-direction: row;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  padding-bottom: 7pt;
  border-bottom: 0.75pt solid var(--hairline);
}

.running-title {
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 9pt;
  font-style: italic;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.running-author {
  font-size: 7pt;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.chapter {
  flex-grow: 1;
}

.running-foot {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  bottom: -24pt;
  left: 0;
  font-size: 7.5pt;
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.chapter-head {
  margin-bottom: 20pt;
  padding-bottom: 16pt;
  border-bottom: 0.75pt solid var(--hairline);
}

.chapter-head-following {
  margin-top: 4pt;
}

.chapter-label {
  margin-bottom: 6pt;
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 13pt;
  font-style: italic;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.chapter-title {
  margin-bottom: 8pt;
  font-family: var(--display);
  font-size: 30pt;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.05;
}

.standfirst {
  max-width: 260pt;
  font-size: 10pt;
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.paragraph {
  margin-bottom: 8pt;
  font-size: 10pt;
  line-height: 1.6;
  text-align: justify;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.lead-in {
  font-size: 8.5pt;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.6pt;
  color: var(--ink);
}
</style>
```

## Research paper

![First page of the research paper template](/gallery/paper.webp)

A three-page journal article: a masthead and the abstract on page 1, then a body in two balanced columns. Two SVG figures and two tables float to the top or bottom of a column, and the text links to them and to the numbered references. The running head starts on page 2 with `pages="continuation"`, and each section is a bookmark.

Uses: [Columns]($docs.styles#columns), [Internal links]($docs.contents-links-bookmarks#named-destinations-and-internal-links), [Fixed pages]($docs.page-breaking#fixed-content-and-pages), [Floats]($docs.styles#floats), [Figures]($docs.accessible-pdf#figures-with-a-caption).

Source: [`playground/pdfs/paper.vue`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/paper.vue), with [`pdfs/components/paper/PaperBackMatter.vue`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/paper/PaperBackMatter.vue), [`pdfs/components/paper/PaperFigure.vue`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/paper/PaperFigure.vue), [`pdfs/components/paper/PaperFigureBars.vue`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/paper/PaperFigureBars.vue), [`pdfs/components/paper/PaperFigureScatter.vue`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/paper/PaperFigureScatter.vue), [`pdfs/components/paper/PaperFrontMatter.vue`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/paper/PaperFrontMatter.vue), [`pdfs/components/paper/PaperTable.vue`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/paper/PaperTable.vue), [`pdfs/components/paper/PaperText.vue`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/paper/PaperText.vue), [`pdfs/components/theme.ts`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/theme.ts), [`shared/paper.ts`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/shared/paper.ts).

::collapse
```vue [playground/pdfs/paper.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Paper } from '../shared/paper'
import { samplePaper } from '../shared/paper'
import PaperFigureBars from './components/paper/PaperFigureBars.vue'
import PaperFigureScatter from './components/paper/PaperFigureScatter.vue'
import PaperBackMatter from './components/paper/PaperBackMatter.vue'
import PaperFrontMatter from './components/paper/PaperFrontMatter.vue'
import PaperTable from './components/paper/PaperTable.vue'
import PaperText from './components/paper/PaperText.vue'
import { paperTheme } from './components/theme'

defineOptions({ name: 'ResearchPaperPdf' })

type PaperProps = { paper: Paper }

const props = defineProps<PaperProps>()
const paper = props.paper

definePdf<PaperProps>({
  title: ({ paper }) => paper.title,
  filename: () => 'research-paper.pdf',
  language: 'en',
  sampleData: { paper: samplePaper },
})
</script>

<!-- eslint-disable vue/singleline-html-element-content-newline, vue/max-attributes-per-line -->
<template>
  <PdfDocument
    :author="paper.authors.map(author => author.name).join(', ')"
    :conformance="['PDF/A-3a', 'PDF/UA-1']"
    creator="Nuxt PDF"
    :subject="paper.journal"
  >
    <PdfPage size="A4" class="page">
      <!-- The first page has the masthead; the running head starts on page 2. -->
      <PdfView fixed pages="continuation" class="running-head">
        <PdfText>{{ paper.shortTitle }}</PdfText>
        <PdfText>{{ paper.journal }} {{ paper.volume }} ({{ paper.year }}) {{ paper.article }} · <PdfPageNumber /></PdfText>
      </PdfView>

      <PaperFrontMatter :paper="paper" />

      <!-- Two columns, balanced where they end. Each section is a bookmark; a
           heading keeps 40 pt of its section below it. Figures and tables
           float to the top or the bottom of a column. -->
      <PdfView class="body">
        <PdfView v-for="section in paper.sections" :id="section.id" :key="section.id" :bookmark="section.title" tag="section">
          <PdfText tag="h2" class="heading" :min-presence-ahead="40"><PdfText class="number">{{ section.number }}</PdfText> {{ section.title }}</PdfText>
          <template v-for="(block, index) in section.blocks" :key="index">
            <PdfText v-if="block.kind === 'h3'" tag="h3" class="subheading" :min-presence-ahead="30">{{ block.title }}</PdfText>
            <PaperText v-else-if="block.kind === 'p'" :parts="block.parts" />
            <PaperTable v-else-if="block.kind === 'table'" :table="block.table" :float="block.float" />
            <PaperFigureBars v-else-if="block.figure === 'bars'" :species="paper.species" :float="block.float" />
            <PaperFigureScatter v-else :sites="paper.sites" :float="block.float" />
          </template>
        </PdfView>
        <PaperBackMatter :items="paper.backMatter" :references="paper.references" />
      </PdfView>
    </PdfPage>
  </PdfDocument>
</template>

<style>
/* The paper's own look (paperTheme in components/theme.ts). */
:root {
  --ink: v-bind('paperTheme.ink');
  --muted: v-bind('paperTheme.muted');
  --hairline: v-bind('paperTheme.hairline');
  --accent: v-bind('paperTheme.accent');
  --reading: v-bind('paperTheme.reading');
  --label: v-bind('paperTheme.label');
}

  hyphens: auto;

  padding: 52pt 54pt 50pt;

  font-size: 8.2pt;
  line-height: 1.36;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.running-head {
  position: absolute;
  top: 28pt;
  right: 54pt;

  justify-content: space-between;
  padding-bottom: 6pt;
  border-bottom: 0.5pt solid var(--hairline);
  font-family: var(--label);
  font-size: 6.5pt;
  color: var(--muted);
}
.body {
  columns: 2;

}
.heading {

  font-family: var(--label);
```

## Business letter

![First page of the business letter template](/gallery/letter.webp)

A one-page business letter with a letterhead, an information block, a subject line and a signature block. The address sits in the window of a DL envelope as DIN 5008 form B places it: 20 mm from the left, 45 mm from the top, 85 × 45 mm, with the return address in its top 17.7 mm. Fold marks at 105 mm and 210 mm and a hole mark at 148.5 mm are decorative views, and the footer is fixed to the bottom of the page.

Uses: [Styling and layout]($docs.styling-and-layout), [Styles]($docs.styles), [Fixed content and pages]($docs.page-breaking#fixed-content-and-pages), [SVG graphics]($docs.svg-graphics), [Page sizes]($docs.page-sizes).

Source: [`playground/pdfs/letter.vue`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/letter.vue), with [`pdfs/components/theme.ts`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/pdfs/components/theme.ts), [`shared/letter.ts`](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/nuxt-pdf/blob/main/playground/shared/letter.ts).

::collapse
```vue [playground/pdfs/letter.vue]
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Letter } from '../shared/letter'
import { sampleLetter } from '../shared/letter'
import { theme } from './components/theme'

defineOptions({ name: 'BusinessLetterPdf' })

type LetterProps = { letter: Letter }

const props = defineProps<LetterProps>()
const letter = props.letter

// The address lines in the window, in postal order.
const addressLines = [
  letter.recipient.name,
  letter.recipient.attention,
  letter.recipient.street,
  letter.recipient.city,
  letter.recipient.country,
].filter(line => line !== undefined)

definePdf<LetterProps>({
  title: ({ letter }) => letter.subject,
  filename: () => 'letter.pdf',
  language: 'en',
  sampleData: { letter: sampleLetter },
})
</script>

<template>
  <PdfDocument
    creator="Nuxt PDF"
    subject="Business letter"
  >
    <PdfPage
      size="A4"
      class="page"
    >
      <!-- Letterhead: the 45 mm above the address field. -->
      <PdfView class="letterhead">
        <PdfSvg
          width="24"
          height="24"
          view-box="0 0 22 22"
          class="mark"
          decorative
        >
          <PdfRect
            x="0"
            y="0"
            width="22"
            height="22"
            rx="6"
            :fill="theme.primary"
          />
          <PdfPath
            d="M6 15 C 8 8, 13 6, 17 6 C 16 11, 12 15, 6 15 Z"
            fill="#FFFFFF"
          />
        </PdfSvg>
        <PdfView>
          <PdfText class="brand">
            {{ letter.sender.name }}
          </PdfText>
          <PdfText class="brand-line">
            Landscape architects
          </PdfText>
        </PdfView>
      </PdfView>

      <!-- Address field of a DL window envelope, DIN 5008 form B:
           20 mm from the left, 45 mm from the top, 85 × 45 mm. -->
      <PdfView class="address-field">
        <PdfView class="return-zone">
          <PdfText class="return-line">
            {{ letter.sender.name }} · {{ letter.sender.street }} · {{ letter.sender.city }}
          </PdfText>
        </PdfView>
        <PdfView class="address-zone">
          <PdfText
            v-for="line in addressLines"
            :key="line"
            class="address-line"
          >
            {{ line }}
          </PdfText>
        </PdfView>
      </PdfView>

      <!-- Information block, beside the address field. -->
      <PdfView class="info-block">
        <PdfView
          v-for="reference in letter.references"
          :key="reference.label"
          class="info-row"
        >
          <PdfText class="info-label">
            {{ reference.label }}
          </PdfText>
          <PdfText class="info-value">
            {{ reference.value }}
          </PdfText>
        </PdfView>
        <PdfView class="info-row info-date">
          <PdfText class="info-label">
            Date
          </PdfText>
          <PdfText class="info-value">
            {{ letter.date }}
          </PdfText>
        </PdfView>
      </PdfView>

      <!-- Fold marks at 105 mm and 210 mm, the hole mark at 148.5 mm. -->
```
